headline: Neither selected generated-data arm exceeded the historical selected CRNN on three-seed mean test macro F1.

interpretation.supported: Neither selected augmentation arm beat the historical selected CRNN on mean test macro F1 in this first evaluation.
not_supported: Generated data causes lower CRNN accuracy.
VAE v3 or diffusion augmentation is worse than a matched cached-real-only control.
One favorable CRNN seed is sufficient evidence of improvement.
interpretation.primary_caveat: The historical reference is one seed trained through the earlier on-the-fly WAV path; the augmented arms are three-seed means trained with fixed cached real spectrograms and have no matched cached-real-only control.
secondary_caveats: The selected-ratio validation margins are small relative to seed variation.
The historical v1 manifests contain nine validation clips duplicated byte-for-byte in training, but no identified duplicate reaches test.

recommended_next_step: Use content_safe_v2 and multiple generated-pool seeds for future augmentation sweeps. A matched cached-real-only control would be needed for a causal estimate but is not scheduled by this report.
